🔥 Daily DSA Routine

Warm-up (30–60 min)

Do 3–4 of the array drills again from memory (pick random ones).

Goal: train speed + no silly mistakes.

Main Task (90–120 min)

Take 1 real LeetCode question in Two Pointers.

Workflow (from your ritual doc):

Decode → Brute Force → Pattern Hunt → Invariant → Optimize → Code → Review.

Log it in your Problem Log (Name | Pattern | Invariant | Time/Space | Gotchas).

Quick Post-mortem (10 min)

Note any slips: off-by-one, wrong condition, pointer update, etc.

Add 2 mini-variants to test yourself tomorrow.
